title: Console cost-clarity wave orchestration & microlearning handbook
creator: Aisha N. Patel
description: Create an operational playbook to coordinate the release notes, training, and cross-team go-to-market activities for the new Cost Clarity widgets, per-route cost breakdowns, and rollout controls in Console. Focus on short microlearning assets, persona-specific release notes snippets, and an adaptive wave rollout with gated metrics and rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes package (core + persona snippets) published to support-site and product-release repo
Training micro-modules (three 7-10 minute videos) published and linked in enablement hub
Wave 1 pilot released to internal beta orgs with telemetry dashboard and success metric signals configured
Cross-team playbook reviewed and approved by ENG, DESIGN, SUPPORT, SALES during readiness sync
Fallback policy and automated rollback runbook validated in staging (simulated incidents)
tasks: Draft persona-based release notes: FinOps, Platform Engineers, Product Managers
Create 3 microlearning videos: Overview, Admin walkthrough, Troubleshooting
Assemble one-pager cheatsheets for Sales/CS with FAQ and pricing impact examples
Coordinate with Eng to wire telemetry gates (error rate, 95p latency, token-cost variance)
Schedule two enablement office hours (1 before wave, 1 during wave)
Publish release notes to /docs and internal release channel; notify marketing for external comms
Prepare demo sandbox with sample org data and Cost Clarity preset views
Run a regression smoke in staging and record results in the playbook
comms_timeline: T-21: Internal product walkthrough to Support and Sales (recorded)
T-14: Release notes + persona snippets distributed to GTM; enablement hub populated
T-7: Microlearning modules live; invite pilot customers and internal beta orgs
Day 0: Wave 1 internal beta flip; public release notes published
Day 3: Office hours and feedback triage; decide Wave 2 go/no-go
Day 14: Upgrade Wave 2 to broader opt-in if key metrics stable
rollout_plan: Adopt a three-wave rollout. Wave 1: internal beta (5 orgs + Redwood internal), Wave 2: opt-in customer cohort (20 orgs) with paid customers flagged in billing, Wave 3: gradual GA open for all. Each wave gated by metric thresholds (error rate <= 0.5%, 95p latency within 1.3x baseline, token-cost deviation < 12%). If any gate fails, trigger automatic fallback to safe model variant and notify on-call + PM+Design for triage.
training_plan: Microlearning-first approach: three short modules (product overview, admin setup, troubleshooting). Pair each module with a one-page quick reference and a 30-minute lab exercise in the demo sandbox. Training owners: Enablement lead (Claire O'Brien), PM host (Aisha Patel). Track completions in enablement LMS and require Sales/CS completion for wave 2 invitations.
decisions: Use persona-snippet approach for release notes to reduce GTM friction
Adopt microlearning videos (<=10m) rather than long webinars to increase completion rates
Telemetry gates chosen to prioritize reliability then cost accuracy
Initial GA will not include auto-enabling quantization recommendations to avoid surprise cost behavior
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Customers misinterpret per-route cost breakdowns and change budgets unexpectedly; Mitigation: include clear examples in release notes and a default-safe UI with confirmation flows
Risk: Increased token-cost variance in certain models after rollout; Mitigation: flag customers for manual review and provide recommended batching/quantization settings
Risk: Support volume spike post-release; Mitigation: prepare triage runbook, canned responses, and dedicated escalation channel
